notes.title: A Letter to Players
notes.notes: [quote][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43495534/428db0c253f80b70b1a34bb8df22711a4d603b19.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I’m mong, the producer of *Dreamless Girl*. Over the past several months, I’ve been entirely focused on development and have been pretty much silent—my apologies for disappearing like that. (Not that anyone probably noticed ╥﹏╥)</p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Since the game’s release, we’ve received a lot of reviews and feedback from players, and we’ve read them all carefully. Among these, the most common and most important concern was: for a visual novel, how could we release the game before the main story was even finished?![/p][p align="justify"]The truth is, we’ve been secretly preparing the story updates all along. The release schedule was finalized after repeated discussions with our publisher, but unfortunately, the story ended at the most awkward point, which hurt the overall experience for many players.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]This was indeed a miscalculation on our part, and we sincerely apologize for it.[/b][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]But please rest assured! Over the past several months, I’ve been working non-stop on the story. The amount of new CGs and character art in this update is almost like remaking the game from scratch. Today, I’m resurfacing to share our detailed plans for what’s next![/p][/quote][p][/p][h3][b]Update Plans[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Here’s how we’re planning future updates and addressing some of the concerns players may have:[/p][olist][*][p align="justify"][b]【Clarification and Compensation for Split Sales】[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Because the story was split during updates, the game experience felt disjointed. Selling future story updates as separate paid DLC would go against the concept of a buy-to-play game and would place unnecessary pressure on the loyal players who have supported us from the beginning.[/p][p align="justify"]Therefore, we’ve decided to integrate the content originally planned as DLC—the “Truth Arc” and “Choice Arc” (EP05~EP10), which cover the story through to its conclusion—directly into the base game. This ensures that anyone who has already purchased the game will have full access to the entire main story at no extra cost.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"][b]【Update Timeline and Localization Plans】[/b][/p][p align="justify"]The “Truth Arc” update will be released first on September 30, and this update will only include the Simplified Chinese version.[/p][p align="justify"]Due to production cost limitations, localization of the subsequent arcs will be delayed. Following the “Truth Arc,” the content will initially support only Simplified Chinese, with Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese versions to be added gradually in later updates.[/p][/*][/olist][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]Given our current limitations, we may not be able to update your language version of the story as quickly as we’d like. Thank you very much for your understanding and continued support as we work to improve.[/p]

notes.title: Apology for the Incorrect Bundle Discount Price Setting
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Due to a work oversight, the bundle "LSP Dark Yuri Bundle" released on December 20 encountered an issue. The discount rate was mistakenly set to -71% instead of the intended -17%. The bundle launch coincided with the start of the Winter Sale at 2:00 AM, and a platform outage prevented immediate correction by our staff. Additionally, communication errors and delayed follow-up by relevant personnel further hindered prompt rectification, ultimately resulting in a large number of users purchasing the bundle at an abnormally low price.

This incident has impacted two games: DreamlessGirl by REZEROR STUDIO and The Street of Adrift by Caramel-Mocha Studio. The mistake caused significant losses to both studios and negatively affected players who recently purchased the games at higher prices. Our brand reputation and the trust of our partners were also damaged.

Here, we sincerely apologize to everyone affected by this error. We are truly sorry!

[h3]Issue Resolution[/h3]
After the issue occurred, we immediately contacted REZEROR STUDIO and Caramel-Mocha Studio to explain the causes and circumstances in detail. Both studios showed initial understanding and stated that as long as remedial measures are properly implemented, lessons are learned, and similar issues are prevented, they would refrain from pursuing further responsibility. We deeply appreciate the studios' generosity.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48575/LSP_Dark_Yuri_Bundle/
After corrections, the bundle returned to its original price on December 21, ensuring no impact on existing users’ games or future purchases by new users.

[h3]Remedial Measures[/h3]
To address the unfairness caused to players who recently purchased these games, we will implement the following measures:
[list]
[] Refunds for price differences: Users who purchased either game between December 12, 00:00 AM and December 20, 02:00 AM can apply for a refund of the price difference caused by the erroneous discount. LSP will bear the cost of these refunds.
[] Application method: Please submit your purchase and payment information by January 6 at the following link: [url=https://www.wjx.top/vm/QfoUEYW.aspx]https://www.wjx.top/vm/QfoUEYW.aspx[/url].
[*] Refund timeline: After verifying the information, we will complete the refunds by January 15.
[/list]
[h3]Appreciation for New Players[/h3]
While this error has led to an unintended encounter, we are delighted that more players can experience these games. We are very grateful for your purchase and hope this opportunity allows you to appreciate the exceptional value and charm of these titles. We look forward to your feedback on your gaming experience.

[h3]Commitment to Improvement[/h3]
We understand the harm this incident has caused to the trust of our players and partners, and we have learned a profound lesson. To prevent similar issues in the future, we will enhance our inspection processes, strengthen communication, and improve responsiveness. We welcome supervision from players and partners alike. Your trust is our most cherished asset. LSP will continue striving to provide better services in the future.

If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us at support@lspsp.me.

Once again, we extend our sincerest apologies to all players, REZEROR STUDIO, and Caramel-Mocha Studio, and thank you for your support and understanding!

LoveStoryProject
December 23, 2024
